About us

Welcome to LDSTAR Africa Language Centre

LDSTAR Africa Language Centre is dedicated to disseminating language knowledge and skills to professionals and members of academia. Through training in local, African and international languages, we aim to strengthen communication, cultural understanding and global engagement.

Learn a language. Expand your world.

More about LDSTAR Africa

Language programmes

Explore Our Languages

Discover opportunities to learn languages that connect communities, cultures and the wider world.

  • 01 Hello

    English

    Build the confidence to communicate clearly in a language of international business, diplomacy and scholarship.

    Learn more
  • 02 Habari

    Kiswahili

    Learn more

    African Languages

    Engage with the continent’s rich linguistic heritage. Contact us to enquire about the African languages available.

    Learn more

    Learn more

    Spanish

    Learn more

    French

    Communicate across the many African countries where French is widely spoken, and beyond.

    Learn more
  • 07 你好

    Chinese

    Gain language skills that support trade, investment and cultural exchange between Africa and China.

    Learn more
